bull_bear.body:
- Earnings depend entirely on subsidiary performance — The parent is a holding entity that 'has invested in various subsidiaries and is focusing on scaling up their operation' and appointed no employees during the year, so its results are driven by three wholly owned subsidiaries rather than by any operating business of its own.
- Concentration in a small, unrelated group of subsidiaries — The group comprises just three wholly owned subsidiaries in unrelated activities - paper and packaging (SPNP Paper and Pack), garments (Yug Fashion Garments) and fintech (Paynov8) - with no associate or joint venture, so the loss of any one materially changes the group's profile.
- Execution risk in the newly added Fintech business — Management attributes the 'very promising' outlook and expected 'accelerated momentum' to the addition of the Fintech business, a vertical only consolidated from 1 April 2025, so the stated outlook rests on an unproven new line.
- Macroeconomic and geopolitical exposure — Management states business prospects 'are closely linked to the economic environment prevailing locally and escalating geopolitical hostilities', which it identifies as the principal external swing factor.
- Loss-making at the standalone level — The MD&A discloses that the Company incurred a loss during the year under review against a profit in the previous year, reversing the 'steadily improving' performance narrative stated in the same report.
- Contingent exposure through a guarantee to a subsidiary — The Company has provided a guarantee of Rs 5 Crores to wholly owned subsidiary SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited - a material off-balance-sheet exposure relative to paid-up capital of Rs 8 Crores.
- Related-party concentration and key-person dependence — The related-party note records that director Mr. Devan Pandya holds more than 20% in subsidiary SPNP Paper and Pack Pvt Ltd, and the Company has no employees; governance and operations rest on a very small set of individuals, with two Company Secretary changes during the year.
- Thin risk-management disclosure — The Board states 'at present there is no identifiable risk which, in the opinion of the Board may threaten the existence of the Company', and the MD&A 'Opportunities and Threats' section contains only generic template wording rather than a company-specific assessment, so investors get no enumerated risk register.

business.body: The Company operates as an investment/holding entity: the Directors' Report and MD&A describe it as having 'been deploying its resources productively; it has invested in various subsidiaries and is focusing on scaling up their operation.' As at 31 March 2026 it holds three wholly owned subsidiaries - SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited, Yug Fashion Garments Private Limited and Paynov8 Private Limited (earlier Auro Fintech Private Limited) - with no associate or joint venture company. The Company itself appointed no employees during the year, and management attributes its improving outlook to 'the addition of Fintech business'.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited — subsidiary: Wholly owned subsidiary (100% shareholding per Form AOC-1). Paper and packaging. The Company provided it a corporate guarantee during the year. It divested its entire holding in Fine Papyrus Private Limited on 16 March 2026. The related-party note also flags it as a company in which director Mr. Devan Pandya has significant influence by virtue of holding more than 20% shareholding.
- Yug Fashion Garments Private Limited — subsidiary: Wholly owned subsidiary (100% shareholding per Form AOC-1). Fashion garments.
- Paynov8 Private Limited — subsidiary: Wholly owned subsidiary (100% shareholding per Form AOC-1), previously known as Auro Fintech Private Limited; became a wholly owned subsidiary with effect from 1 April 2025 per the related-party note. Fintech - management credits the addition of this business for the improved outlook.
- Fine Papyrus Private Limited — subsidiary: Former step-down subsidiary held through SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited; ceased to be a step-down subsidiary with effect from 16 March 2026 following divestment of the entire holding (Directors' Report, cross-bundle).
- M/s JNV Infra Pvt Ltd — related party: Listed in the related-party note under entities where control exists; no activity or relationship detail is given in the annual report text and no transaction with it is described.
- Darpan Shah — related party: Key Management Personnel named in the related-party note; the note's transaction table lists an 'Issue of shares/bonus shares' line against his name, but the figures are not readable from the routed text.
- Shreya Pandya — related party: Named in the related-party note under the Key Management Personnel / relatives block; role not stated in the routed text.
- Amit Sinkar — related party: Named in the related-party note under the Key Management Personnel / relatives block; role not stated in the routed text.
- Amit Patankar — related party: Named in the related-party note under the Key Management Personnel / relatives block; also appears in a board/committee attendance fragment in the Directors' Report.
- Kavita Shah — related party: Chief Financial Officer, named as Key Management Personnel in the related-party note.
- Swapna Shivashankaran — related party: Company Secretary, resigned with effect from 31 July 2025 (related-party note).
- Krinisha Sanghvi — related party: Company Secretary, appointed with effect from 13 August 2025 (related-party note).

outlook.body:
- Operate as a holding company that deploys resources into wholly owned subsidiaries and focuses on scaling up their operations (MD&A, Industry Structure and Development).
- Build out the newly added Fintech vertical through wholly owned subsidiary Paynov8 Private Limited (earlier Auro Fintech Private Limited), which management credits for the improved outlook.
- Simplify the group's step-down structure: SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited divested its entire holding in Fine Papyrus Private Limited, which ceased to be a step-down subsidiary with effect from 16 March 2026 (from the Directors' Report, cross-bundle).
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The annual report discloses no capacity addition, plant commissioning or capital-expenditure project. Expansion is described only in corporate-structure terms: the Company invests in and is scaling up its wholly owned subsidiaries (SPNP Paper and Pack, Yug Fashion Garments and Paynov8 Private Limited, earlier Auro Fintech, which became a wholly owned subsidiary with effect from 1 April 2025 per the related-party note in the governance bundle), and management credits the addition of the Fintech business for its improved outlook. In the opposite direction, SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited divested its entire 9,90,000-share holding in Fine Papyrus Private Limited, which ceased to be a step-down subsidiary with effect from 16 March 2026. The Company is an asset-light holding entity with no employees appointed during the year, and no plants, capacity or project timelines are stated anywhere in the routed sections.
